title: [main] [E-Documents][PEPPOL] V1 import fails for UBL invoices using alternate cac/cbc namespace prefixes
summary: PEPPOL import for UBL invoices now handles alternate XML namespace prefixes correctly by matching elements through namespace URI instead of lexical prefix matching.
key_points: Fixed V1 PEPPOL import failures when UBL elements use alternate namespace prefixes like cac1 and cbc1
Changed namespace matching from lexical prefix-based to URI-aware namespace resolution
Added URI awareness with multiple aliases and namespace-scope validation to codeunit 6166
Added regression test coverage for complete V1 parsing including invoices, credit notes, attributes, attachments, lines, and document charges
quote: V1 PEPPOL import fails when equivalent UBL 2 elements use alternate namespace prefixes such as cac1 and cbc1.
